name: Magesh Jayaraj
headline: Delivery Leader | Healthcare | Salesforce Professional Services
about:
As Senior Director of Professional Services at Salesforce, I serve as a trusted advisor, enabling our strategic clients to ideate, design and execute large-scale business and IT transformational programs. Leveraging 25 years of deep experience across consulting and industry, I focus on delivering tailored solutions that empower organizations to achieve their strategic objectives. 

My expertise spans generative AI, sales, and business development, with a history of leading digital and cloud transformation initiatives across industries including healthcare, technology, media, telecom, retail, and public sector. I am committed to fostering impactful client relationships, driving value through innovative strategies, and supporting teams to realize shared success.
